Tuition Regulation

Section 1. Payment Deadline
Tuition fees for each semester must be paid by September 10 for the fall semester and February 10 for the spring semester.

Section 2. Late Payment
Late payment incurs a penalty of 1% per week until the account is settled.

Section 3. Refunds
Tuition refunds are available only when withdrawal is approved before the fourth week of the semester.
